description: Source code implementing SIMD-accelerated convolution functions (horizontal, vertical, and multi-row) for image processing in the skia graphics library, specifically using SSE2 instructions.

methods.name: ConvolveHorizontally_SSE2
methods.description: Performs horizontal convolution on a single image row using SSE2 instructions.

methods.name: Convolve4RowsHorizontally_SSE2
methods.description: Performs horizontal convolution on four image rows simultaneously using SSE2 instructions.

methods.name: ConvolveVertically_SSE2
methods.description: Performs vertical convolution on image data using SSE2 instructions, with template specialization for alpha channel handling.
